title: Burger King Japan attack leaks 11 million user records
content_md:
After the attack on Burger King Japan, 11 million user data records leaked. Personal data of users was stored on the attacked servers.

via Mastodon https://linuxiarze.pl/po-ataku-na-japonski-burger-king-wycieklo-11-milionow-rekordow-danych-uzytkownikow/
